why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the creator form on the Flop website is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak.
Faucet: claim test FLOP at the devnet faucet .
Explorer: browse blocks and transactions on the devnet explorer .
Builders: the docs cover the SDK (npm i @flop-labs/sdk), the inference API and the MCP server for calling verified inference from an agent. Questions go to Ask Flop .
